messages:
Lisa Gomez: Hey @security — new intake from Cascade Health. They sent a SIG/CAIQ request and want details on KMS/HSM, network segmentation, and SOC2 evidence. Sales ticket #INC-6942 created. POC: Mike (mike@cascadehealth.com). Target date is 2024-12-05. Can someone own the CAIQ and an initial cover note?
Alex Chang: Assigning this to Jordan. Jordan — can you confirm our SOC2 link and whether we can support customer-managed keys for their use-case?
Jordan Lee: I can take ownership. Quick answers: we have SOC2 Type II; link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2 (internal). For keys: Hosted API doesn't support customer-managed keys. Dedicated + Private support KMS/HSM integrations. Do we know which deployment they're targeting?
Lisa Gomez: They said Dedicated or Private. I'll confirm, but initial ask implies Dedicated with VPC + HSM.
Maria Singh: Pinged Mike: he replied "Dedicated with VPC + HSM likely" and asked about in-flight encryption and who holds keys.
Jordan Lee: Noted. I'll draft the CAIQ and call out the KMS caveat. ETA EOD tomorrow PST for draft CAIQ + cover note.
Alex Chang: FYI add Riley from infra for network diagrams and firewall details.
Riley Park: I'll produce VPC/network diagrams and export firewall rules. Need their expected IP ranges to produce a peering diagram.
Lisa Gomez: Mike said he will send IP ranges by EOD today.
Jordan Lee: Draft CAIQ uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/drafts/cascade-health-caiq. Asking Alex + Riley to review — I'll flag KMS as a conditional capability and propose mitigation (Dedicated with customer-managed HSM).
Alex Chang: Quick nit: on key-rotation Q add our 90-day rotation policy + HSM escrow language. :thumbsup:
Maria Singh: If we can get CAIQ + network diagram by tomorrow I can push the contract/data-handling clause to legal.
Riley Park: Uploaded network diagrams and egress policy to the doc. Left placeholders for their IP ranges.
Jordan Lee: Final CAIQ + cover note uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/caqi/cascade-health-final. Marked ticket #INC-6942 as assigned and moved to awaiting-customer for IP ranges and signatures.
Lisa Gomez: Great work team — I'll chase Mike for the signatures. Marking this thread resolved from sales-side for now. :rocket:
